The evidence conflicts: Tenant 3 says the Falcons lead with 16 points, while Tenant 4 says the Wolves lead with 19 after a points correction.

The two sources come from different "tenants," so they may not describe the same league or the same time. Tenant 4 explicitly mentions a correction, which suggests it is the more recent and updated figure. Tenant 3 gives a full table, but it may be outdated. Tenant 4's Wolves total of 19 is also higher than any figure in Tenant 3's table, which is consistent with a correction raising their total.

Neither source can be verified against actual match results, so I'm choosing the one that reflects a correction.
